title: Avengers: Endgame
description: The surviving Avengers assemble for one final, universe-spanning showdown against cosmic forces and the fallout of past choices.

title: Interstellar
description: A team of explorers ventures across a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity, guided by hope, science, and love.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
description: With the world knowing his identity, Peter Parker seeks help from Doctor Strange and faces multiverse consequences.

title: Jawan
description: A fearless vigilante crosses into dangerous territory as personal duty and public justice collide in a high-stakes mission.

title: Inception
description: A thief who steals secrets through dreams is offered a chance to erase his past by planting an idea into a target's mind.

title: 3 Idiots
description: Three friends reunite after years apart, revisiting their college days, friendship, and the pressure of ambition.
